_doc: Sprint 8 effect-extraction receipts. Each strict A-core record gets one receipt. Pooling reads only receipts that pass validate_extraction(); the rest are documented extraction failures.

evidence_quotes: a higher dose of metformin (200 mg/kg) resulted in 100% lethality of I/R mice while the untreated I/R mice showed 100% survival (Fig. 1h).

we orally treated mice with lower dose 50 mM metformin for 7 days before renal I/R surgery, and surprisingly we found that metformin-aggravated I/R-induced AKI, inducing > 50% death within 24 h (Fig. 1i).
h Kaplan–Meier survival curves of mice in the I/R and I/R+Met200 (200 mg/kg i.p.) groups (n = 10 mice per group).
i. Kaplan–Meier survival curves of mice in the I/R and I/R+Met50 (50 mM o.a.) groups (n = 10 mice per group).
receipts.failure_reason: No numeric survival data (e.g., median survival time) is provided; survival outcomes are described qualitatively.
